beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Tokyo makes translation infrastructural across permission, venue, moving image, language, textile exchange, recognition and retained seasons. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: The organizer operates Japanese and English interfaces across programme, brands, topics and organizational information.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The organizer operates Japanese and English interfaces across programme, brands, topics and organizational information. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The interface carries names, categories, access conditions and venue information across languages, but translation depth varies by record.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No reviewed public record documents one season-wide translation workflow, glossary, error process or accessibility standard.
